text: Okay, like I literally just told you. I don't want to wait. I want to get this resolved now. Like I said, I want to return the office stuff. Can I just cancel the whole order? That's the only thing that makes sense now. No, that doesn't work for me. Can I just talk to someone who can actually fix this?
zh: 好的，就像我刚才告诉你的。我不想等。我现在就想解决这个问题。就像我说的，我想退回办公室用品。我能直接取消整个订单吗？现在这是唯一合理的选项。不，那对我来说行不通。我能和一位能实际解决这个问题的人谈谈吗？
